versions.changelog:
- Updated homepage URL from /claude-code-skill to /openclaw in metadata.
- No functional or workflow changes.

- Initial release of AppScreenshotStudio skill.
- Generate production-ready App Store and Play Store screenshots from your codebase.
- Automatically reads app colors, screens, and copy to create finished screenshots in the correct store dimensions.
- Guides you through context gathering, user confirmation, and screenshot set generation.
- Supports iterative editing and renders final PNGs for export.
- Highlights credit costs and provides error code details for troubleshooting.
